title: Sticky Tofu & Mushroom Bowl
style: Crispy roasted tofu and shiitake mushrooms with bold five-spice flavour and a punchy soy-chili glaze.
description: Golden roasted tofu and mushrooms tossed in a savoury soy–chilli glaze, served over rice with quick-pickled cucumber and fresh herbs.

items.note: patted dry and broken into pieces

steps: Heat oven to 450°F (230°C). Cook rice according to package directions.
Roast Tofu: Pat tofu dry and break into small pieces on a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with 2 tbsp oil, season with five-spice powder and ~¼ tsp salt. Toss gently and roast 10 min.
Quick Pickle: Toss sliced cucumber with rice vinegar and ~¼ tsp salt. Set aside.
Add Mushrooms: Toss mushrooms with remaining 2 tbsp oil and ~¼ tsp salt. Scatter over tofu and gently mix. Roast another 8–10 min until golden and crisp.
Glaze: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, and chilli garlic sauce. Pour over tofu-mushroom mixture and roast 2 min more to caramelize.
Serve tofu and mushrooms over rice with pickled cucumber, scallions, sesame seeds, and cilantro.
tips: Extra-firm silken tofu roasts especially crisp while staying tender inside.
Add a squeeze of lime or drizzle of sesame oil to finish.
Works great with jasmine rice, brown rice, or quinoa.
